[[Ssissth the Leviathan]] is a [[Wurm]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Jaga Moraine]].

== Locations ==
* [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Jaga Moraine}} (before completing [[Prenuptial Disagreement]])

== Quests ==
'''Quests involved in:'''
* [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
** [[Prenuptial Disagreement]]

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Aftershock}}
* {{skill icon|Churning Earth}}
* {{skill icon|Earthquake}}
* {{skill icon|Shockwave}}  ([[elite]])

== Notes ==
* It does huge amounts of [[Area of Effect|AoE]] damage and often causes [[knockdown]].
* Replaced by [[Edielh Shockhunter]] after completion of [[Prenuptial Disagreement]].
* [[Pain Inverter]] will be useful, as it will trigger more often due to the AoE, and additionally up to three times per ally because of Shockwave.
* This boss, like most Wurm bosses, does not need to be killed when [[vanquish]]ing as long as it is not above ground.
* If this boss dies while underground, you will not be able to [[Signet of Capture|capture]] skills from it.
